newsitem.title: USA: Eastman Kodak to reshape division - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Eastman Kodak to reshape division - WSJ.

text.p: Eastman Kodak Co will announce Wednesday its plans for a new advertising and branding campaign intended to reposition its Professional & Printing Imaging division among professional photographers, the Wall Street Journal reported Wednesday.
Kodak will simply change the name of the operation to "Kodak Professional" and try to capture more of the market, which has seen tougher competition, especially from Fuji Photo Film Co Ltd .
The division, with annual revenues of about $2.5 billion, provides film, paper, equipment and services to portrait and wedding photographers, graphic artists and photojournalists.
